title: Generate a 2D top down map from a tileset with AI?
author: bebitou
selftext:
Hello, I want to use a basic tileset pack to create a simple map for a prototype. I gave the tileset to the AI and it generated something almost usable but still requires a lot of tweaking. Most of the time, it uses the wrong tiles, so for example, it will use a tile of an object in place of a wall, inserting objects into walls :D 

  
I'm wondering what can I do? I tried to use several level editor but I don't have the faith nor time to learn this new skillset (and I don't find the tools very ergonomical either), I just want to make one map of 64x64 tiles.

  
Should I draw a doodle and use it as a guideline for the AI? what else?

comments.author: Alexguitar11
comments.body: You just have to guide it. Maybe label out each tile as to what it is. Usually it can guess for itself but you might need to just tell it these tiles are only for the ground and tell how often or where and what type. You could also draw something out and give it specific directions. After that you can go in and refine little parts here and there as needed. I had drawn out a map for my game and for the most part it got it pretty spot on but i did have to go back and change some things

comments.author: vriemeister
comments.body: Have the ai make a simple level editor just for you?

comments.author: romansamurai
comments.body: I’ve done it. I have a ton of assets (both purchased from Synty and other places and some I’ve created while learning blender) and I’ve guided both Claude and CGPT to build maps/rooms/dungeons utilizing them. And to create some small new ones in blender and edit existing ones as needed. It’s so much faster to have them do it and then tell them what to correct than doing it yourself

replies.author: bebitou
replies.body: ok but do you tell the ai to isolate the map as in a dedicated file format, then you tell this tile is wrong, these tiles are wrong ertc?? mb with screenshots and doodles?

replies.author: romansamurai
replies.body: I have it work on it in unity and I can see as it’s working. But I also tell it to show me the work in a screenshot of the angle the camera will be or if free cam then all angles.  If you build it in unity it’s just maps you can view anytime too. But I more often than not now list go off screenshots at this point. Then play test it when it’s as finished as I can get it that way and look for anything bad.

comments.author: UnderLord7985
comments.body: You still have to guide the AI, for me i use folders put the name on it for what it is, then tell the ai "cave walls are in cave-walls folder under darkcave use that and cut it into tiles for easy placement" or whatever youre doing. Hell i have a 3d space station creator where o had ai make a tool add in snapping ability to all sides and i just snap the pieces together, of course i had to tell it to use only the prefabs and which ones to use.

comments.author: berlingoqcc
comments.body: I was going my map with ldtk before and the format is JSON and claude is alright for modify or generating new level from your stuff.

comments.author: Slight-Living-8098
comments.body:
Can I ask why you want to try to use a LLM for something a simple procedural map generation algorithm will suffice for? 

Just have the AI create you a procedural tile map generator, or even just go grab one of the numerous free ones off of itch.io or GitHub.
